scanNote: Writing (Project) mashqi kitob oxiridagi 'Photo File' bo'limiga havola qiladi — Paula'ning xati o'sha yerda. Bu yerda mashq matni, tuzilishi va namuna xat berilgan; Photo File betiga yetganda xatning kitobdagi aniq varianti qo'shiladi.

rule.titleUz: ON / IN / UNDER / BEHIND / NEXT TO / IN FRONT OF
rule.explanationUz:
Predlog — narsaning QAYERDA ekanini ko'rsatadigan so'z.
O'zbekchada bu qo'shimcha bo'ladi (stol-DA, stol-NING ostida),
ingliz tilida esa ALOHIDA so'z va otdan OLDIN turadi.

  ✅ on the table   (stol ustida)
  ❌ the table on

Kitobdagi rasm: ko'k kvadrat — narsa, pushti doira — biz gapirayotgan buyum.

rules.enRule: on = on top of / touching the surface
examples: The vase is on the table.
There is a poster on the wall.
The carpet is on the floor.
The flowers are in the vase.
The table is in the room.
The ball is under the table.
There is a bedside table under the poster.
The plant is behind the chair.
Behind the bed there are two windows.
The chair is next to the table.
There is a lamp next to the bed.

rules.enRule: in front of = at the front of
examples: The magazine is in front of the vase.
There is a table in front of the sofa.

rule.warningUz:
ON va IN chalkashtiriladi:
  on the table  — stol USTIDA (tegib turibdi)
  in the table  — noto'g'ri! stolning ICHIDA degani bo'lardi

  in the vase   — guldon ICHIDA (gullar)
  on the vase   — guldon USTIDA (bu boshqa ma'no)

Devor uchun doim ON: 'a poster ON the wall' (in the wall EMAS).
Devorda tuynuk bo'lsagina 'in the wall' deyiladi.
rule.noteUz:
IN FRONT OF — uch so'zdan iborat, uchalasi ham kerak:
  ✅ in front of the chair
  ❌ in front the chair
  ❌ front of the chair

NEXT TO — ikki so'z, 'to' shart:
  ✅ next to the table
  ❌ next the table
rule.extraUz:
Predlogdan keyin OLMOSH kelsa, u OBYEKT shakliga o'tadi:
  on the table → on IT   (uning ustida)
  next to Jenny → next to HER
  behind the boys → behind THEM

Masalan: 'There is a vase on the table with some flowers IN IT.'
('it' = the vase)

exercises.instructionEn: First, look at the picture, then read the short text and underline the correct prepositions.
exercises.instructionUz: Avval rasmga qarang, so'ng qisqa matnni o'qib, to'g'ri predlogni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Kitob betidagi rasmda: table, vase, flowers, magazine, ball,
chair, plant, poster, carpet.

Matn: 'There is a table in the room. There is a vase (1) in/on the table
with some flowers (2) in/on it. There is a magazine (3) under/in front of
the vase. There is a ball (4) behind/under the table. There is a chair
(5) next to/under the table. There is a plant (6) behind/in front of the
chair. There is a poster (7) on/in the wall (8) next to/under the plant.'

Har bir raqamda rasmga qarang va narsa qayerda turganini toping.

items.textEn: There is a vase (1) ____ the table.
items.whyUz: Guldon stol USTIDA turibdi. 'in the table' — stolning ichida degani bo'lardi, bu ma'nosiz.
Gullar guldon ICHIDA. 'it' — bu yerda 'the vase'.

items.textEn: There is a magazine (3) ____ the vase.
items.whyUz: Jurnal stol ustida, guldonning OLDIDA yotibdi — ostida emas.

items.textEn: There is a ball (4) ____ the table.
There is a chair (5) ____ the table.
There is a plant (6) ____ the chair.
There is a poster (7) ____ the wall...
items.whyUz: Devorga osilgan narsalar uchun doim ON ishlatiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: This is Sally's living-room. Ask and answer questions using the prompts below.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu — Sallining mehmonxonasi. Quyidagi so'zlar yordamida savol berib, javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
Namuna:
  SA: Are there any pictures on the wall?
  SB: Yes, there are. There are some pictures on the wall.

QOLIP:
  Savol (ko'plik): Are there any + ot + predlog + joy?
  Savol (birlik):  Is there a/an  + ot + predlog + joy?

  Javob (ha, ko'p):  Yes, there are. There are some ...
  Javob (yo'q, ko'p): No, there aren't. There aren't any ...
  Javob (ha, bitta):  Yes, there is. There is a ...
  Javob (yo'q, bitta): No, there isn't. There isn't a ...

DIQQAT: qisqa javobdan keyin TO'LIQ gap ham aytiladi — kitobdagi namuna shunday.

items.question: Are there any pictures on the wall?
items.answer: Yes, there are. There are some pictures on the wall.
items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. Devorda ramkali rasmlar bor.

items.question: Is there an armchair next to the fireplace?
items.answer: Yes, there is. There is an armchair next to the fireplace.
items.whyUz: Rasmda kaminning chap tomonida gulli kreslo turibdi. 'an armchair' — unli tovush bilan boshlanadi.

items.question: Are there any plants behind the sofa?
items.answer: Yes, there are. There are some plants behind the sofa.
items.whyUz: Divanning orqasida katta yashil o'simliklar turibdi.

items.question: Is there a fireplace under the mirror?
items.answer: Yes, there is. There is a fireplace under the mirror.
items.whyUz: Kamin ustida oyna osilgan, ya'ni kamin oynaning ostida.

items.question: Is there a fridge in the living-room?
items.answer: No, there isn't. There isn't a fridge in the living-room.

items.question: Is there a table in front of the sofa?
items.answer: Yes, there is. There is a table in front of the sofa.
items.whyUz: Divan oldida past jurnal stoli turibdi.

items.question: Are there any magazines on the table?
items.answer: Yes, there are. There are some magazines on the table.

items.question: Are there any cushions on the sofa?
items.answer: Yes, there are. There are some cushions on the sofa.
items.whyUz: Divanda bir nechta naqshli yostiqcha bor.

items.question: Are there any posters on the wall?
items.answer: No, there aren't. There aren't any posters on the wall.
items.whyUz: Devorda ramkali rasmlar bor, lekin plakat yo'q. picture ≠ poster.

items.question: Are there any vases on the table?
items.answer: No, there aren't. There aren't any vases on the table.
items.whyUz: Stol ustida idish va jurnal bor, guldon yo'q.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture and read the text, then fill in next to, on, behind or under. Finally, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang va matnni o'qing, so'ng next to, on, behind yoki under so'zlarini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
Faqat TO'RTTA predlog ishlatiladi: next to, on, behind, under.
Har biri kamida bir marta kerak bo'ladi.

Rasmda: gilam, karavot va yostiq, ikkita deraza, chiroq,
yozuv stoli va stul, jurnallar, rasmlar va plakat, karavot yonidagi stol.

Matnni o'qiyotganda 'it' kimga/nimaga ishora qilayotganini toping —
u oldingi gapdagi narsa bo'ladi.

lines.textEn: It's nice and spacious with a carpet 1) ______ the floor.
lines.uz: U chiroyli va keng, polda gilam bor.
lines.whyUz: Gilam pol USTIDA yotadi → on the floor.

lines.textEn: There is a very comfortable bed with a pillow 2) ______ it.
lines.uz: Juda qulay karavot bor, ustida yostiq turibdi.

lines.textEn: 3) ______ the bed there are two windows.
lines.whyUz: Derazalar karavot ORQASIDA. Gap boshida — katta harf bilan.

lines.textEn: There is a lamp 4) ______ the bed.
There is a chair 5) ______ it and some magazines 6) ______ it.
lines.uz: Uning yonida stul, ustida esa jurnallar bor.
lines.whyUz: Stul stol YONIDA (next to), jurnallar stol USTIDA (on). 'it' = the desk.

lines.textEn: Jenny has got some pictures and a poster 7) ______ the walls.
lines.uz: Jennining devorlarida rasmlar va plakat bor.
lines.whyUz: Devorga osilgan narsa uchun doim ON.

lines.textEn: There is also a bedside table 8) ______ the poster.
lines.uz: Yana plakat ostida karavot yonidagi stol bor.

lines.textEn: Jenny likes her bedroom a lot.
lines.uz: Jenni o'z yotoqxonasini juda yaxshi ko'radi.

exercises.instructionEn: Finally, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Nihoyat, namunadagidek savol berib, javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
Namuna:
  S1: Where is the carpet?
  S2: It's on the floor. Where is the pillow?

'Where is ...?' — Qayerda? Javobi predlog bilan boshlanadi.

Qisqartma: It is → It's. Og'zaki nutqda doim qisqartiladi.
Ko'plik uchun: 'Where are the windows?' — 'They're behind the bed.'

DIQQAT: har bir o'quvchi javob berib, KEYINGI savolni beradi.
Shunday qilib suhbat uzluksiz davom etadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the Photo File section and complete Paula's letter to her friend telling her about her new flat and her favourite room.
exercises.instructionUz: Photo File bo'limiga qarang va Paulaning do'stiga yozgan xatini to'ldiring — u yangi kvartirasi va eng yoqtirgan xonasi haqida yozadi.
exercises.explanationUz:
DO'STGA XAT — norasmiy uslub.

XAT TUZILISHI:
  1) Salomlashish:  Dear Ann,
  2) Kirish:        Nega yozayapsiz (yangi kvartiraga ko'chdim)
  3) Asosiy qism 1: Kvartira qanday? (joylashuvi, hajmi, xonalari)
  4) Asosiy qism 2: Eng yoqtirgan xona va undagi narsalar
  5) Yakun:         Write soon. / Hope to see you soon.
  6) Xayrlashish:   Love, / Best wishes,
                    Paula

KERAKLI TILDAN FOYDALANING:
  There is / There are — nima borligini aytish
  Predloglar (on, in, under, behind, next to, in front of) — qayerdaligi
  Sifatlar (spacious, comfortable, modern, lovely) — qanaqaligi

Quyidagi namuna xat — shu qolip bo'yicha yozilgan. Uni o'qib chiqing,
keyin o'zingizning uyingiz haqida shunday xat yozing.

structure.modelEn: How are you? I've got some news — we have got a new flat!
It is in a quiet street near the city centre and it is very spacious.
There are two bedrooms, a modern kitchen, a bathroom and a comfortable living-room.
My favourite room is my bedroom.
There is a single bed with a bedside table next to it and a big wardrobe behind the door.
There is a desk in front of the window and there are some posters on the walls.
I like it a lot because it is nice and quiet.
Write soon and tell me about your house.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and tick. Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va belgilang. Qayta tinglab, takrorlang.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kitobda audio bor. Ilovadagi ovoz tugmasi orqali so'zni eshitib, farqni sezishingiz mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKITA 'A' TOVUSHI:

  /æ/  — qisqa, og'iz keng ochiladi, 'a' va 'e' orasidagi tovush.
         O'zbekcha 'a' ga o'xshaydi, lekin yoyiqroq: cat, flat, attic

  /ɑː/ — uzun, chuqur 'aa'. Til orqaga tortiladi: car, garden, plant

Bu farq MA'NONI o'zgartiradi:
  cat /kæt/  — mushuk
  cart /kɑːt/ — arava

Britan inglizchasida 'plant', 'dance', 'ask' — /ɑː/ bilan.
Amerika inglizchasida esa /æ/ bilan aytiladi. Darslik BRITAN talaffuzida.

OSON QOIDA: so'zda 'ar' bo'lsa — deyarli doim /ɑː/:
  garden, carpet, armchair, car, park

wordFormation.introUz: 21-bet — predloglar va ular bilan ishlatiladigan olmoshlar.

groups.ruleUz: Bir so'zli va ko'p so'zli predloglar
groups.explanationUz: Ba'zi predloglar bitta so'z, ba'zilari 2–3 so'zdan iborat. Ko'p so'zli predloglar BUTUN holda yodlanadi — bir bo'lagini tashlab bo'lmaydi.
Ega olmoshi predlogdan keyin OBYEKT shakliga o'tadi.
'Where is ...?' savoliga javob berganda deyarli doim qisqa shakl ishlatiladi.

items.note: MUTLAQO boshqa so'z! its = egalik, it's = it is

patterns.formula: Where is/are + ot? — It's / They're + predlog + joy.
patterns.exampleEn: Where is the carpet? — It's on the floor.
patterns.explanationUz:
Birlik: Where IS ...? → IT'S ...
Ko'plik: Where ARE ...? → THEY'RE ...
Javobda ot takrorlanmaydi, olmosh ishlatiladi.

patterns.exampleEn: There is a ball under the table.
patterns.explanationUz:
Avval NIMA borligi, keyin QAYERDA ekani aytiladi.
O'zbekchada teskari: avval joy, keyin narsa.

patterns.formula: Are there any + ko'plik + predlog + joy? — Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.
patterns.exampleEn: Are there any pictures on the wall? — Yes, there are. There are some pictures on the wall.
patterns.exampleUz: Devorda rasmlar bormi? — Ha, bor. Devorda rasmlar bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
Qisqa javobdan keyin TO'LIQ gapni ham aytish — kitobdagi namuna shunday.
Bu gapirish mashqida to'liq javob berishga o'rgatadi.

patterns.exampleEn: a bed with a pillow on it / a vase with some flowers in it
patterns.exampleUz: ustida yostiq bor karavot / ichida gullar bor guldon
patterns.explanationUz:
'with' + narsa + predlog + 'it' — bitta narsani boshqasi bilan bog'lab tasvirlaydi.
'it' oldingi otga ishora qiladi.

patterns.formula: Behind/In front of + joy, there is/are ...
patterns.exampleEn: Behind the bed there are two windows.
patterns.explanationUz:
Predlogli ibora gap BOSHIDA ham turishi mumkin — tavsifni jonli qiladi.
Bunda 'there is/are' undan keyin keladi.
